name: argos
description: ARGOS — plateforme de commandement pour la gestion des catastrophes.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix packages/api-client && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.clean:cache: node -e "for (const p of ['apps/web/.next','apps/api/dist','apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('fs').rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('caches de build supprimés')"
